environment: Headless egui rendered-composer test. The visible Retry model list action was clicked while the Gateway was unavailable; no authenticated live Gateway or packaged Windows runtime was used.
notes: Partial evidence for PAR-0218. Retry remains outside the nested picker error row and the regression verifies the typed draft, attachment, active runtime session and profile remain unchanged through a failed retry. Live Gateway recovery and source-paired acceptance remain open.
